construct: Reabsorbed bile acids activate FXR in ileal enterocytes, inducing FGF19 secretion into portal blood. FGF19 activates hepatic FGFR4/β-Klotho signaling and represses CYP7A1, the rate-limiting enzyme of the classic bile-acid synthesis pathway.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Reabsorbed ileal bile acids activate FXR, inducing FGF19; portal FGF19 signals via hepatic FGFR4/β-Klotho to suppress CYP7A1 and new bile-acid synthesis.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: HMG-CoA reductase is central to cholesterol synthesis, but the canonical ileal endocrine feedback target for bile-acid synthesis is CYP7A1.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: The temporal gut-liver endocrine signal after ileal bile-acid uptake uniquely maps to FGF19-mediated CYP7A1 repression.
